scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items! -
scripts.translation: - 您攜帶的物品太多了！ -

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmmm...
I can feel a strange force growing stronger and stronger, somewhere in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
嗯...
我感覺到米德加爾特某處有一股奇怪的力量正在不斷增強。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be
going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你能感覺到嗎？
一定有什麼事要發生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm waiting for the day when I'll finally get to see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that one of these days, my dream will become reality.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我一直在等待能親眼看到托爾雷霆的那一天。我相信總有一天，我的夢想會成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You came back!
In exchange for the ores that you have brought me, I will give you one of my family treasures.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你回來了！
作為對你帶來礦石的回報，我會送你一件家傳寶物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You have two options in choosing a treasure. You can have a treasure that will be useful to yourself, or something that may suit one of your friends.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
寶物有兩種選法：挑一件自己用得上的，或是挑一件適合朋友的。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
So which treasure
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
那麼，你想選擇哪件寶物呢？

scripts.text: An item that I can use.
scripts.translation: 我自己能用的

scripts.text: An item that my friend can use.
scripts.translation: 朋友能用的

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for you.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
明白了...
請稍等，我去找一件適合你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for your friend.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
明白了...
請稍等，我去找一件適合你朋友的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Okay, let's see...
I seem to recall that I put it somewhere around... Hmm.
It must be around--Ah!
Here we are~
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
讓我找找...記得是放在這附近...嗯。
應該就在...啊，找到了~

scripts.text: Unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Once again, I thank you for the trouble you've gone through on my behalf. I'm unsure of how this works, but I hope it will be useful to you. From what I know, I believe this is a rare item.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
再次感謝你替我奔波。
這東西怎麼用，我也不清楚，不過希望能幫到你。
據我所知，它應該很稀有。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'll be waiting for the day when I'll see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that the dream I've had will come true, one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我會繼續等待親眼看到托爾雷霆的那一天。我相信我懷有的夢想，總有一天會成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I need
50 Rough Oridecon
and 50 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我需要：
50個神之金屬原石，
還有50個鋁原石。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I don't have much time, so go ahead and continue on your journeys if you can't bring those to me.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我時間不多，如果你無法把這些帶給我，就請繼續你的旅程吧。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我感覺到這片大陸的某處有一股奇怪的能量正在變得更強...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你能感覺到嗎？
一定有什麼事要發生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我想，還是先等等，看發生了什麼。
總會有人帶來訊息，只是不知道會是喜訊，還是噩耗...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You've met the four Dwarven Blacksmiths. I've heard that they rarely speak to humans. So you must be special if you were able to talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你見到了四位矮人鐵匠？
聽說他們很少跟人類說話。
能讓他們開口，你一定很特別。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Do you think that my dream will come true? Do you believe Thor's Mjolnir will appear before the eyes of humans? I'm afraid great change will come to this world.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你說，我的夢想會實現嗎？
托爾的雷神之錘，真的會出現在人類面前嗎？
恐怕這個世界要發生鉅變了。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you for going through such trouble on my behalf. I wish to give you one of my family treasures as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
謝謝你為我費心。我想送你一件家傳寶物，以表謝意。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
However, I hope you understand that my family would grow suspicious if one of the treasures were to just go missing.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
不過，希望你能理解，如果一件寶物突然失蹤，我的家人肯定會起疑心。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm, however, I don't think they'll complain if I exchanged one of the treasures for something else. Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
嗯，不過如果他們知道我是用一件寶物換了別的東西，應該就不會抱怨了。讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I should be able to give you
one of our family heirlooms if you can bring be 50 Rough Oridecons and 50 Rough Eluniums.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果你能給我50個神之金屬原石和50個鋁原石，我就可以送你一件家傳寶物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You don't have to do that if you don't want to. But it seems our family heirlooms would be more useful to an adventurer such as yourself...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果你不願意，也可以不做。但看來這些家傳寶物對你這樣的冒險者更有用...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm...
The Dwarven Blacksmiths
must be upset at you for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
嗯...
矮人鐵匠們一定因為某件事對你很不滿。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Remember my sister's
suggestion and speak to
them with great courtesy.
Carefully choose words
of respect lest they
be insulted.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
記住我姐姐的叮囑，對他們一定要畢恭畢敬。
說話時仔細斟酌，別失了禮數。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You should be okay now.
By this time, they've probably forgotten the insult. But make sure you speak to my sister for advice first.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
現在應該沒問題了。
到這個時候，他們大概已經忘了那件事。但記得先去找我姐姐問問建議。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Sorry for the trouble.
I wish you good luck
in finding the Dwarves!
Just... Don't insult them!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
抱歉給你添麻煩了。
祝你在尋找矮人時好運！
只是...千萬別冒犯他們！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我感覺到這片大陸的某處有一股奇怪的能量正在變得更強...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你能感覺到嗎？
一定有什麼事要發生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我想，還是先等等，看發生了什麼。
總會有人帶來訊息，只是不知道會是喜訊，還是噩耗...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
One of my ancestors supposedly was a servant of Thor. Still, I find it difficult to believe.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
據說，我有位祖先曾經是托爾的僕人。
不過，這實在很難相信。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If the gods have all these powers, how could a mere human be of any real assistance?
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果眾神擁有如此強大的力量，區區人類又能幫上什麼忙呢？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Last night, I had the most amazing dream where I was the servant of Thor, god of thunder.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
昨晚，我做了一個不可思議的夢，夢裡我是雷神托爾的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
In this dream, I traveled
with Thor to Jotunnheim, land of giants. During our journey, he told me many interesting stories about gods and heroes.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
在夢中，我跟隨托爾前往巨人國度約頓海姆。旅途中，他給我講了許多關於眾神和英雄的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Of course, I can't remember everything clearly, but it was truly fantastic.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
當然，我記不清所有細節，但那真的非常精彩。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
For some reason, I can vividly recall what Thor told me about his weapon, Mjolnir. Mjolnir is a Dwarven masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
不知為什麼，托爾談起武器雷神之錘時說的話，我卻記得清清楚楚。
那可是矮人的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thor told me that Dwarves are extremely talented artisans, and their works are supreme. So as
I was thinking about my dream,
I remembered...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
托爾說，矮人是天賦非凡的工匠，作品舉世無雙。
回想起這段夢境，我忽然想到...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
There is a mountain that
has the same name as Thor's
weapon. Surely, the two have
some relation to each other.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
有一座山與托爾的武器同名。這兩者之間肯定有某種聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I've also recently heard a rumor that Dwarven Blacksmiths also reside on Mount Mjolnir.
I understand the mountain is dangerous, and that I'm in no position to ask such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
最近我還聽到一個傳聞，說矮人鐵匠也住在妙勒尼山脈上。
我知道那座山很危險，我也知道我不該提出這樣的要求...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I can't help wanting to know for myself whether or not there is truth to my dream. Is it possible for Mjolnir to resurface?
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我實在想知道，這個夢到底有沒有依據。
雷神之錘真的有可能重現於世嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If you don't mind, I'd like to ask you to explore this mountain and search for these Dwarven Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果不介意的話，我想請你探索這座山，尋找這些矮人鐵匠。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see. But I still appreciate that you took the time to listen to me.
Hopefully someday I'll learn the truth about my dreams and about Mjolnir itself.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我明白了。但我還是很感激你願意花時間聽我傾訴。
希望有一天我能弄清我夢境的真相，以及雷神之錘本身的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you,
thank you so much!
Even though it won't be easy, I have faith that if the Dwarven Blacksmiths do exist, you'll be able to find them.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
謝謝，真是太感謝你了！
雖然不容易，但我相信，只要那些矮人鐵匠確實存在，你就一定能找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Oh, and please speak to my sister Roskva first. She is outside the North Entrance of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
哦，對了，請先去和我姐姐羅絲克瓦對話。她在普隆德拉北門外面。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm sure that she can
give you useful information if you're fortunate enough to encounter the Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
她肯定能告訴你一些有用的事，讓你有幸遇到矮人時，知道該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm truly lucky to meet such an adventurer like yourself. I wish you the best of luck.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
能遇到像你這樣的冒險者，我真的很幸運。祝你一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I believe in you.
Just be courageous!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我相信你。
只要勇敢一點就好！

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
矮人鐵匠非常看重禮數。
跟他們說話，要是有半點不敬，他們可是會發怒的。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the East.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
所以，儘可能禮貌地與矮人對話非常重要。
你要拜訪的第一位矮人在東方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the North.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
請沿順時針方向繞米德加爾特行進，按順序尋找其他矮人。你的最終目的地在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
要是不小心弄錯了拜訪順序，就再回去找提亞爾菲吧。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
矮人鐵匠非常看重禮數。
跟他們說話，要是有半點不敬，他們可是會發怒的。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the North.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
所以，儘可能禮貌地與矮人對話非常重要。
你要拜訪的第一位矮人在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a counter clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the East.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
請沿逆時針方向繞米德加爾特行進，按順序尋找其他矮人。你的最終目的地在東方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
要是不小心弄錯了拜訪順序，就再回去找提亞爾菲吧。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
A long time ago, many people used to frequent this area. Friends and families would live here, sharing happiness and sadness.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
很久以前，這一帶常有人來往。
親朋好友住在這裡，有福同享，有難同當。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
But they're all gone now. My parents and my friends have all gone to a place whose name I don't even know.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
但現在他們都走了。我的父母和朋友們都去了一個我甚至不知道名字的地方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
I can't help
but feel lonesome...
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
我忍不住感到孤獨...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
這片大陸的某處正在發生著什麼。你可能不信，但我不斷看到芬里爾之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
這片大陸的某處正在發生著什麼。你可能不信，但我不斷看到芬里爾之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
When my people finally retrieve the memories of their past, we will be able to grant the power of the gods to humans.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
當我的族人最終找回過去的記憶時，我們將能夠賦予人類神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I believe that
time is coming...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
我相信那個時刻就要到了...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm? I sense that you were asked to do a favor for that human. If I were you, I'd finish that task as soon as I could. Somehow, that human's fate, as well as that of the Dwarves, are intertwined...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
嗯？感覺是那個人類請你來幫忙的。
換作是我，就儘快把事情辦妥。
不知為何，那個人類的命運，竟跟我們矮人緊緊相連...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What is it?! I refuse to speak to human as rude and contemptible
as you! Now, get out of my sight!
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
什麼？！
你這種粗魯可鄙的人類，我沒什麼好說的！
滾出我的視線！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?
I have nothing
to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
什麼...？
我沒什麼想對你說的。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm...?
Why have you
come to me, human?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
嗯...？
你為何來找我，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Hey, 'sup!
scripts.translation: 嘿，你好啊！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?!
Do not greet the
Dwarves lightly,
mortal!
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
什麼？！
凡人，跟矮人打招呼，豈能如此輕慢！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What has made
you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
是什麼事讓你來找我？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，先生

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Ah, I see that the entire human race is not worthy of scorn. Unlike many of your kind, I see that you respect your elders.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
啊，原來人類也不全都令人鄙夷。
和你許多同類不同，你倒是懂得尊敬長者。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
So what did
want to ask
me about?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
那麼你想問我什麼？

scripts.text: About Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 關於雷神之錘

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Mjolnir...?
Thor's legendary weapon?
The hammer than can shake the earth and tear the sky asunder? Out of all of legendary weapons, Mjolnir is perhaps greatest.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
雷神之錘...？
托爾那把傳說中的武器？
能撼動大地、撕裂天空的神錘？
諸般傳奇兵器裡，它或許當屬第一。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
As a matter of fact, it was forged by my ancestor. Mjolnir was the perfect weapon, except for one minor flaw.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
實不相瞞，那是我祖先打造的。
除了一個小小的缺陷，雷神之錘堪稱完美。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
The hilt of Mjolnir was forged shorter than intended. Are you still listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
錘柄比原本打算的短了些。
你還在聽嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，先生！

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Austri]
One day, Loki came to our village and showed off his treasures. He boasted that we couldn't possibly create something to surpass their quality.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]

[Austri]

made by another Dwarf tribe, but we couldn't tolerate his insult. So my ancestors created three treasures of their own.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
其實，他那些寶物也是另一支矮人部族打造的，可我們受不了這份羞辱。
於是，祖先們又打造出了三件寶物。

scripts.text: Boooring!
scripts.translation: 好無聊！

scripts.text: Oh, wow.
scripts.translation: 哇，好厲害

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Of the three treasures my ancestors created, Mjolnir was the last and greatest.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
三件寶物裡，雷神之錘最後問世，也最為出色。

[Austri]

[奧斯特里]

[Austri]
It's very sad. Although Mjolnir is the greatest weapon ever, it was very close to being the epitome of craftsmanship.

[奧斯特里]
實在遺憾。

scripts.text: Epito--what?

scripts.text: Yes sir, I agree.

[Austri]

[奧斯特里]

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Mjolnir was the trusted weapon Thor wielded on the battlefield, and every giant feared its power.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
雷神之錘是托爾在戰場上信賴的武器，每一個巨人都畏懼它的力量。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I must say, a Blacksmith's greatest pride comes when he creates the weapon and armor that can be considered his life's work.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
要我說，鐵匠最大的驕傲，就是打造出足以代表自己畢生心血的武器和防具。

scripts.text: I agree, sir!
scripts.translation: 我同意，先生！

scripts.text: Um, yeah.
scripts.translation: 嗯，是的

[Austri]
The reason this mountain is called Mount Mjolnir is because it was actually created by the hammer.

[奧斯特里]
這座山之所以叫妙勒尼山脈，是因為它實際上是由這把錘子創造的。

[Austri]

[奧斯特里]

scripts.text:
[Austri]
You can imagine just
how powerful Mjolnir is.
However, humans can never hope to see or even wield Mjolnir. Only a god can handle that kind of force.

[奧斯特里]
足見雷神之錘的威力。

那樣的力量，唯有神能駕馭。

scripts.text: Wah wah wah~!
scripts.translation: 哇 哇 哇~!

scripts.text: Ah, I understand sir!
scripts.translation: 啊，我明白了，先生！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hmm... But perhaps an ambitious dwarf can forge something similar to Mjolnir so that it can actually be used by humans. It would have less power, but it'd be perfectly crafted.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
嗯...但也許有志氣的矮人，能打造一件類似的武器，供人類使用。
威力會弱些，做工卻能完美無缺。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Yes, it's possible to create
a Mjolnir suited to humans. Still, it wouldn't be very easy.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
是的，可以創造出適合人類的雷神之錘。不過，這並不容易。

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，先生！

scripts.text: Yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 嗯，隨便吧

[Austri]
Well, I happened to speak much longer than I intended. But I hope you learned what you wished to
know about Mjolnir.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
不知不覺，竟說了這麼久。
不過，你想知道的雷神之錘的事，應該也都聽到了吧。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I feel that a great change is coming. I do not know what kind
of effect it will have on our world, but something important will happen...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
我感覺巨大的變化即將到來。我不知道它會對我們的世界產生什麼影響，但重要的事情將會發生...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Perhaps only the gods can be
sure as to what the future will bring. In any case, we must prepare ourselves for what will happen.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
也許只有神才能確定未來會帶來什麼。無論如何，我們必須為即將發生的事情做好準備。

scripts.text: Yes?
scripts.translation: 是的？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，先生！

[Austri]
Alright then...
If you wish to learn more, you should speak to my brothers.
Take care, human.

[奧斯特里]

[Austri]

You're not listening, are you?! What a waste of my time!

白白浪費我的時間！

[Austri]

scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]

understand. If you

[奧斯特里]

[Austri]
What has made
you come to me?

[奧斯特里]
是什麼事讓你來找我？

scripts.text: Nothing.

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
A respectable blacksmith cherishes his tools and crafts with diligence and care.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
值得尊敬的鐵匠，都會愛惜工具，做工認真仔細。

[Austri]
When it comes to humans, I believe the ones who can appreciate my line of work are the only ones worth talking to.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]

scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]

scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]

祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[奧斯特里]
Zzzz Zzzz...

I have nothing

...
scripts.translation:

...

Leave immediately and go study your english properly!

you come to me?

[Austri]

[Austri]
So what did
want to ask
me about?

scripts.text: About Mjolnir.

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Mjolnir...?
Thor's legendary weapon?

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Ah...
It feels like today's going to be a great day.
scripts.translation:

啊...
感覺今天會是美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Austri]

scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
陽光暖和，林間空氣清新，錘子和鐵砧也都齊備。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

and fight with stronger and stronger opponents!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

嗚哈哈哈ha!

one day when I get back to Svartalfaheimr

Muhahahaha...!
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sudri]

[蘇德里]

想打敗我，你還不夠強！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]

scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
出去練練，變強了再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你比我強。
我沒想到會遇到像你這麼強的人類。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
真讓我佩服！
好，我會向朋友們誇誇你。
希望我的兄弟們，能幫上你想辦的事。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
那麼，旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
So...
What brings
you here, human?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
那麼...
人類，你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much time on your hands. Why don't you log out and hang out with your buddies for a while?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你閒得發慌了。
不如下線去跟你的朋友們聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
哼。你和其他人類不太一樣。
不過，僅僅因為你懂禮貌就信任你，這可不是什麼明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
我最愛的，就是赤手空拳，按老規矩狠狠幹一架。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
嘴上說的未必可信。
不過，要是你能打贏我，我倒可以跟你談談。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 好，我接受挑戰

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你甚至都沒回答我！
算了！隨你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
啊，我已經開始喜歡你了，人類！
現在，你不妨去熱熱身，等你準備好了我們再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
呃...？
你為什麼這麼膽小？
你是怕我這個又老又小的矮人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
來吧，我甚至會讓你先出手。
等你準備好戰鬥了就來找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
Zzzz Zzzz...

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
[Sudri]
Get out of here before I beat you to death! All you can gain over here is a few herbs, anyway!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
[蘇德里]
在我把你打死之前趕緊滾！
反正你在這裡只能採到幾株草藥而已！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
That was a great fight!
Hahahahahahahahahaah!
I regret nothing.
I may have lost, but
I gave it my all!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
打得痛快！
Hahahahahahahahahaah!
我沒有遺憾。
雖然輸了，可我已經拼盡全力！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?

[蘇德里]
是什麼讓你來找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much

scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你閒得發慌了。
不如下線去跟你的朋友們聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Why should
I excuse you?
Do you want to
fight with me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
憑什麼要我讓你打擾？
怎麼，想跟我打一場？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Cool, let's fight!

[蘇德里]
好，那就打吧！

scripts.translation: 蘇德里獲勝！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Muhahahaha!
You're not strong enough to beat me! I want someone who can offer
me a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
Muhahahaha!
想打敗我，你還不夠強！
我要的，是能讓我痛快打一場的對手！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Go out, train some and get stronger before you even think about coming back!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
出去練練，變強了再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你比我強。
我沒想到會遇到像你這麼強的人類。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
真讓我佩服！
好，我會向朋友們誇誇你。
希望我的兄弟們，能幫上你想辦的事。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
那麼，旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
是什麼讓你來找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much
time on your hands.
Why don't you log out and go out with your friends instead?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你閒得發慌了。
不如下線去跟你的朋友們聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
哼。你和其他人類不太一樣。
不過，僅僅因為你懂禮貌就信任你，這可不是什麼明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
我最愛的，就是赤手空拳，按老規矩狠狠幹一架。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
嘴上說的未必可信。
不過，要是你能打贏我，我倒可以跟你談談。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 好，我接受挑戰

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你甚至都沒回答我！
算了！隨你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
啊，我已經開始喜歡你了，人類！
現在，你不妨去熱熱身，等你準備好了我們再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
呃...？
你為什麼這麼膽小？
你是怕我這個又老又小的矮人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
來吧，我甚至會讓你先出手。
等你準備好戰鬥了就來找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
Zzzz Zzzz...

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
In a one on one fight, you put everything on the line to show your might to your opponent.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
一對一較量，就得豁出一切，讓對手見識自己的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Have you ever felt the same way I do, human? Win or lose, just giving your all is the most satisfying accomplishment.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
人類，你也有過這樣的感覺嗎？
不論勝負，只要傾盡全力，就是最大的滿足。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
Zzzz Zzzz...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
如果你想要什麼，就應該靠自己的努力去爭取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不管別人說什麼，只要相信自己、意志堅定，就一定能坦然接受結果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你覺得呢？
現在的年輕人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't feel
like doing anything
today. Anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
我今天什麼都不想做。
什麼都...不想做...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Someone must have forged something really monstrous, otherwise I wouldn't be feeling so worthless!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
一定是有人鍛造出了驚世之作，不然我怎麼會覺得自己這麼沒用！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Yeah, I think I need a break! Don't you think I need a break, human?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
是啊，我覺得我需要休息一下！
你不覺得我也該休息一下嗎，人類？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing like taking a relaxing break after putting your heart into your work.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
全心投入工作後，沒有什麼比放鬆休息更愜意的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think,
human? Isn't that one
of life's simple pleasures?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你覺得呢，人類？
這不是生活中簡單的樂趣之一嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
如果你想要什麼，就應該靠自己的努力去爭取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不管別人說什麼，只要相信自己、意志堅定，就一定能坦然接受結果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你覺得呢？
現在的年輕人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I really hope I meet a decent human being next time. So far, I haven't met one useful human.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
真希望下次能遇到個靠譜的人類。
到目前為止，我還沒遇到過有用的人類。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Perfect preparation does not always result in success. There's a point when you've got to just go out and do it.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
完美的準備並不總能帶來成功。
到了某個時刻，你就必須放手一搏。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't know how
big your goals are,
but put your heart into
whatever it is that you
plan to accomplish in life.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不知道你的志向有多遠大，不過不管想做成什麼，都要全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
如果你想要什麼，就應該靠自己的努力去爭取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不管別人說什麼，只要相信自己、意志堅定，就一定能坦然接受結果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You didn't answer the question! Now, you've probably got the wrong Dwarf here...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你沒有回答問題！
現在，你大概找錯矮人了吧...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Get out of here, and go to your human Blacksmiths if you want equipment upgrades!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
出去！
想精煉裝備，找你們人類自己的鐵匠去！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Great...!
Which one should I upgrade first, huh? My heart is pounding with anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
好...！
先精煉哪件呢？
真期待，心都怦怦跳起來了...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What...?!
This isn't upgradable!
What the hell do you want
me to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
什麼...？！
這根本沒法精煉！
你他媽想讓我拿它做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
哦，好東西！
這件已經精煉到極致了！
可這不是我想要的，已經沒什麼能再加工的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This item isn't even a challenge to upgrade. You can get humans to do this kind of beginner's stuff. Get them to refine it first.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
這東西精煉起來，根本談不上挑戰。
這種入門的活計，找人類做就夠了。
讓他們先精煉一下再來。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Come on...
Bring me something
that presents an
element of risk!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
拜託...
給我拿點有風險的東西來！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Armor?!
Didn't I tell
you that I only work
on Level 4 weapons?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
防具？！
不是說了，我只精煉4級武器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You can have a human
Blacksmith work on that kind of stuff! Now, a Dwarf like me needs something that's more of a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
這種活兒你去找人類鐵匠做吧！像我這樣的矮人，需要的是更有挑戰性的工作！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hey...
Don't insult me by expecting me to work on anything less than a Level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
喂...

of Thor's journeys into Utgard,
land of the giants.
scripts.translation:

這是關於托爾前往巨人國度烏特加德的一段傳說。

scripts.text:

the giants of their land in tests of skill and strength.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]

actually a giant. Illusion was used to disguise Thor's opponent, but I forget was it was. Do you know?

scripts.text: Thoughts
scripts.translation: 思想

scripts.text: Turtle
scripts.translation: 烏龜

scripts.text: Wolf
scripts.translation: 狼

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, right! Tialfi was racing 'thoughts!' Nothing can move faster than the speed of thought, so it's no wonder Tialfi would always lose.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
對，提亞爾菲是在跟“思想”賽跑！
什麼也快不過念頭，難怪他總是輸。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
For the final contest, Thor would challenge an old woman in a wrestling match. At first, Thor thought his victory was assured, but he learned that he could not defeat the old crone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
最後一項比賽，托爾要與一位老婦人進行摔跤。起初，托爾以為勝券在握，但他發現根本無法擊敗這位老嫗。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Once again, Thor was the victim
of illusion magic. He didn't realize he wasn't actually wrestling with an old woman. Do you know what his opponent really was?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
這一次，托爾又中了幻術。他並沒有意識到自己實際上並不是在和一位老婦人摔跤。你知道他的對手真正是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Curse
scripts.translation: 詛咒

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 大地

scripts.text: Heart
scripts.translation: 心

scripts.text: Old Age
scripts.translation: 衰老

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, Thor was wrestling with 'Old Age!' No matter how strong anybody is, you can't fight against aging.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，托爾是在和“衰老”摔跤！無論一個人多麼強壯，都無法戰勝衰老。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
After Thor lost every match,
the king told him the truth about the contests. Thor grew furious, but it was too late. The king and the giants all vanished by then.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
托爾輸掉了所有比賽後，國王告訴他了比賽的真相。托爾勃然大怒，但為時已晚。國王和巨人們全都消失了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two lessons
to be learned from this tale. First, don't believe everything you see. Second, never be overconfident of your own power.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
這個故事有兩個道理。
第一，眼見未必為實。
第二，永遠別對自己的力量過分自信。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There will always be someone or something more powerful than you. It is important to always do your best and have an attitude of humility.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
總會有比你更強大的人或事物存在。保持謙遜的態度，並始終盡力而為，這一點很重要。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Try to live as good a life as you can. Remember that you can't have everything that you want. Obssession and irrationality go hand in hand.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
盡力做個好人吧，也要記住，不是什麼想要的東西都能得到。
執念太深，就容易失去理智。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet someone with a dangerous obsession, please tell this story of Thor and the illusions of the giant king.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
謝謝你耐心聽我講完。
若遇到有人執迷不悟，眼看就要走上險路，就給他講講托爾和巨人王幻術的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯...？
好像不對。
讓我想想，興許慢慢就能記起來...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
要不，等我再喝瓶紅色藥水，咱們接著聊？
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Oooh...
I'm sooo thirsty!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哦哦...
我渴死了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯，我不是讓你帶紅色藥水來嗎？嗓子這麼幹，我沒法講故事啊~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你找我有什麼事，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哼。
如果是那樣的話，就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人類想見我和我的兄弟們了。不過，我也不能說他們的來訪不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
有點渴，能帶瓶紅色藥水來嗎？
作為回報，我給你講個重要的故事。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
Zzzz Zzzz...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Eh heh heh~
It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
Eh 嘿嘿~
待在妙勒尼森林裡，真是舒服。
四周安靜祥和，什麼也不用操心...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你不該早就出發了嗎？嗯，這也不是我的事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
如果你有多餘的Zeny，為什麼不買點路上的零食呢？也許是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你找我有什麼事，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哼。
如果是那樣的話，就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
That's fine. Still...
I'm surprised to see
such a polite human.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哼。
那好吧。不過...
見到你這麼有禮貌的人類，我有點驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ah, you've brought
me a Red Potion...?
In return, I will
tell you an old story.
I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
啊，你帶了紅色藥水來...？
作為回報，我會給你講一個古老的故事。
我相信你會喜歡的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There is a story of a Dwarf named Alvis who contained more knowledge than a library and was braver than Siegfried the warrior.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
有個故事，講的是矮人阿爾維斯。
他的知識比一整座圖書館還豐富，勇氣更勝戰士齊格飛。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Unfortunately...
He was too ambitious.
He fell in love with Thrud, Thor's first daughter, at first sight.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
不幸的是...
他太有野心了。
他一見托爾的大女兒特魯德就愛上了她。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
He asked Thor for permission to marry Thrud, but as was expected, Thor refused. Alvis should have given up there, but he didn't.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
他向托爾請求娶特魯德，但不出所料，托爾拒絕了。阿爾維斯本該就此放棄，但他沒有。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor decided to test his knowledge by asking him some questions. The first question was, 'What is the name of the ground in human terms?' Do you know the answer?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
於是托爾決定通過提問來測試他的知識。第一個問題是：“用人類的語言來說，大地的名字是什麼？”你知道答案嗎？

scripts.text: Ymir's body
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾的身體

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 大地

scripts.text: Lane
scripts.translation: 道路

scripts.text: Universe
scripts.translation: 宇宙

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, that's right, 'Earth.' Alvis was able to also answer Thor's question correctly.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，“大地”。
阿爾維斯也答對了這一問。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thor then gave Alvis another question. What is the giant's term for the round shell that covers the earth?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
接著，托爾又問了他一個問題。在巨人的語言中，覆蓋大地的圓形外殼叫什麼？

scripts.text: Ymir's Head
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾的頭

scripts.text: Sky
scripts.translation: 天空

scripts.text: Cloud Factory
scripts.translation: 雲工廠

scripts.text: High House
scripts.translation: 高屋

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
That's it, 'High House.' Since the giants are so huge, it might have looked that way to them.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，是“高屋”。因為巨人非常巨大，所以在他們看來可能就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor gave him another question. What is the term for the ball that rises in the sky at night, as used by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
於是托爾又問了他一個問題。在眾神的語言中，夜晚升上天空的球體叫什麼？

scripts.text: Circling Wheel
scripts.translation: 旋轉之輪

scripts.text: Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text: False Sun
scripts.translation: 假太陽

scripts.text: Fast Stranger
scripts.translation: 飛馳的過客

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes! Gods refer to the
moon as the 'false sun.'
Although Alvis answered all of Thor's questions, he didn't notice the sun was rising.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯！眾神稱月亮為“假太陽”。
雖然阿爾維斯回答了托爾的所有問題，但他沒有注意到太陽正在升起。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes...
Thor prolonged his test so that Alvis would be turned to stone
once the sun rose.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
是啊...托爾故意把問答拖得很長，就是要等到日出，讓阿爾維斯化作石頭。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two
things we can learn
from this story. First, do not covet something to the point of challenging fate or the gods.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
從中能明白兩個道理。
第一，不要為了貪求某樣東西，連命運和神都敢挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Secondly, do not have too much pride in yourself. No matter how much ability or talent you may have, you cannot get everything
you want.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
第二，不要過於自負。無論你的能力或天賦有多高，你都無法得到你想要的一切。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
It's most
important to live a
good and virtuous life. It's great to achieve your desires, but be aware that some desires are not meant to be fulfilled.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
做人，最要緊的是善良正直。
能實現心願當然很好，可有些願望，註定不能成真。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet anyone afflicted with an insatiable desire, please tell him this story of Thor and Alvis, a brave yet very defiant Dwarf.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
謝謝你耐心聽完。
若遇到有人慾壑難填，就把托爾和阿爾維斯的故事講給他聽吧。
那個矮人雖勇敢，卻也太過桀驁。

scripts.text:

Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯...？
好像不對。
讓我想想，興許慢慢就能記起來...

scripts.text:

Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~

哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.translation:

What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你找我有什麼事，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
You're funny, leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你真有趣，別煩我了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人類想見我和我的兄弟們了。不過，我也不能說他們的來訪不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
有點渴，能帶瓶紅色藥水來嗎？
作為回報，我給你講個重要的故事。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
I am Nordri,
Dwarven Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我是諾德里，矮人鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I am in charge of this Northern part of Mount Mjolnir. If you wish to pass, you must first secure my approval!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我負責妙勒尼山脈北部的守衛工作。如果你想通過，必須先得到我的批准！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ho ho ho...
Calm down, it
was only a joke.
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
呵呵呵...
別緊張，開個玩笑而已。
哈哈哈哈哈!

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...
